class.name: Level
class.brief_description: Root node of a playable scene, optionally overriding the game mode.
class.description: The main scene root must be a [Level] for the framework to find it, and so must anything opened with [method World.open_level] or [method World.server_travel]. Set [member game_mode_override] to run this level under different rules from the project default. Pawns are placed at a [PlayerStart2D] or [PlayerStart3D] anywhere below it. They are parented to [code]/root/Pawns[/code] rather than to the level, so that their path is the same on every peer no matter what the level scene is called.
